description: Play one exact audio artifact already bound to the run through the audio-device worker environment. WAV, MP3, FLAC, Vorbis/Ogg, and AAC-in-MP4/M4A are decoded locally; completion, refusal, device failure, and explicit duration-limit interruption return speaker.play.result evidence.

audio_artifact_id.description: Exact id of an audio artifact already bound to this run.

format.description: Declared carrier format used as the decoder hint; the bound bytes must still decode through that supported carrier family.

host.description: Optional exact CPAL host name. Omit it to use the platform default host.

device_name.description: Optional exact output device name. Omit it to use the selected host's default output device.

max_duration_ms.description: Hard playback deadline. Known longer media is refused before playback; unknown-duration media is stopped explicitly at the limit.
